adhar2ghu ghAraNaM, “èNNabhbhaDhuM (ghur2ibhbhiDhDha) jhila nADhghaLaidh dhavira (naragha) nèrubhbhu èGghaLai ar2ave dhINDhAdhu’’ èn2r2u nijhjhayamAgha avarghaL ghUr2iyadhAghuM. in2n2uM, avarghaL dhaGghaLadhu mArghghadhdhil bhòyghaLai iDhDhughghaDhDhi ghUr2i vandhadhu avarghaLai emAr2r2iviDhDhadhu.

Agha, (nabhiye!) ar2ave adhil jhandheghamillAdha òru nALil nAM avarghaLai (uyirbhbhidhdhu) òn2r2u jherdhdhAl; in2n2uM, òvvor AdhmAvuM dhAn2 jhèydhadhar2ghu muzhumaiyAghagh ghUli ghòDhughghabhbhaDhDhAl (abhbhodhu avarghaLin2 nilaimai) èbhbhaDhi (bharidhAbhamAgha) irughghuM? (annALil) avarghaL (jhir2idhuM) anIdhi izhaighghabhbhaDhamADhDhArghaL.

(nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha: “allAhve! ADhjhighaLughghèllAM urimaiyALan2e! nADhiyavarughghu nI ADhjhiyaigh ghòDhughghir2Ay; nADhiyavariDhamirundhu nI ADhjhiyai bhar2ighghir2Ay; nADhiyavarghaLai nI ghaNNiyabhbhaDhudhdhughir2Ay; nADhiyavarghaLai nI izhivubhaDhudhdhughir2Ay; nan2mai èllAM un2 ghaiyildhAn2 irughghir2adhu; nijhjhayamAgha nI òvvòru bhòruL mIdhuM bherAr2r2aluDhaiyavan2.

nI iravaibh bhaghalil nuzhaighghir2Ay; bhaghalai iravil nuzhaighghir2Ay; ir2andhadhilirundhu uyiruLLadhai nI vèLiyAghghughir2Ay; uyiruLLadhilirundhu ir2andhadhai nI vèLiyAghghughir2Ay; nI nADhiyavarughghu ghaNaghghin2r2i vazhaGghughir2Ay.’’

naMbhighghaiyALarghaL, naMbhighghaiyALarghaLaidh dhavira nirAgharibhbhALarghaLai (dhaGghaLadhu) bhAdhughAvalarghaLAgha (udhaviyALarghaLAgha) èDhudhdhughghòLLa veNDhAM. èvar idhaijh jhèyvAro avar allAhvai viDhDhuM nIGghiviDhDhAr. (allAhvuM avarai viDhDhu nIGghiviDhDhAn2. in2n2uM avar allAhvin2 mArghghadhdhai viDhDhu nIGghiyavar AvAr.) nIGghaL (avarghaLin2 Adhighghadhdhil irundhu, avarghaL bhèruMbhAn2maiyAgha irundhu) avarghaLai adhighaM aJjhin2Al dhavira. (abhbhodhu mArghgha viSayadhdhil avarghaLughghu ghIzhbhbhaDhiyAmal, ulagha viSayadhdhil avarghaLuDhan2 mèn2maiyAgha naDhabhbhadhu uGghaL mIdhu ghur2r2amillai). in2n2uM, allAh dhan2n2aibh bhar2r2i uGghaLai èjhjharighghir2An2. allAhvin2 bhaghghaMdhAn2 mILumiDhaM irughghir2adhu.

(nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha: uGghaL nèJjhaGghaLiluLLadhai nIGghaL mar2aidhdhAluM; alladhu, adhai vèLibhbhaDhudhdhin2AluM allAh adhai nan2ghar2ivAn2. in2n2uM, vAn2aGghaLil uLLadhaiyuM, bhUmiyil uLLadhaiyuM (avan2) nan2ghar2ivAn2. in2n2uM, allAh òvvòru bhòruL mIdhuM bherAr2r2aluDhaiyavan2 AvAn2.

òvvor AdhmAvuM nan2maiyil dhAn2 jhèydhadhaiyuM, dhImaiyil dhAn2 jhèydhadhaiyuM (dhan2aghghu mun2) jhamarbhbhighghabhbhaDhDhadhAgha ghANuM nALil, dhan2aghghu madhdhiyiluM, adhar2ghu (-dhImaighghu) madhdhiyiluM nINDhadhUraM irughgha veNDhume! èn2a (dhImai jhèydha AdhmA) viruMbhuM. allAh, dhan2n2aibhbhar2r2i uGghaLai èjhjharighghir2An2. allAh aDhiyArghaL mIdhu migha iraghghamuLLavan2 AvAn2.

(nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha: “nIGghaL allAhvin2 mIdhu an2bhu vaibhbhavarghaLAgha irundhAl èn2n2aibh bhin2bhar2r2uGghaL. allAh uGghaL mIdhu an2bhu vaibhbhAn2; in2n2uM, uGghaLughghu uGghaL bhAvaGghaLai man2n2ibhbhAn2. allAh maghA man2n2ibhbhALan2, maghA gharuNaiyALan2 AvAn2.’’
(nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha: “allAhvir2ghuM dhUdharughghuM ghIzhbhbhaDhiyuGghaL. Agha, nIGghaL bhur2aghghaNidhdhAl nijhjhayamAgha allAh nirAgharibhbhALarghaL mIdhu an2bhu vaighghamADhDhAn2.’’
nijhjhayamAgha allAh, AdhamaiyuM nUhaiyuM ibhrAhImin2 ghuDhuMbhadhdhaiyuM iMrAn2in2 ghuDhuMbhadhdhaiyuM aghiladhdhArghaLaiviDha (dhan2adhu dhUdhudhdhuvadhdhughghAgha) dherndhèDhudhdhAn2.
òru (jhir2andha) jhandhadhiyai (allAh dherndhèDhudhdhAn2). adhil jhilar, jhilaraijh jherndhavar. (avarghaL an2aivarin2 ghòLghaiyuM òn2r2e.) allAh nan2ghu jhèviyur2ubhavan2, nan2ghar2indhavan2 AvAn2.

(nabhiye!) iMrAn2uDhaiya man2aivi, “èn2 ir2aivA! nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 èn2 vayir2r2iluLLa(ghuzhan)dhai(yai ir2aiyAlayadhdhil un2n2ai vaNaGgha) arbhbhaNighghabhbhaDhDhadhAgha un2aghghu nerjhjhai jhèydhen2. Aghave, (adhai) èn2n2iDhamirundhu er2r2ughghòL! nijhjhayamAgha nIdhAn2 nan2ghu jhèviyur2ubhavan2, nan2ghar2indhavan2’’ èn2agh ghUr2iya jhamayadhdhai nin2aivu ghUrvIrAgha!

Agha, (iMrAn2uDhaiya man2aivi) avaLaibh bhèr2r2èDhudhdhabhodhu, “èn2 ir2aivA! nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 avaLaibh bhèNNAgha bhèr2r2èDhudhdhen2. - avaL bhèr2r2èDhudhdhadhai allAh migha ar2indhavan2. (indha) bhèNNaibh bhon2r2u (andha) AN illai. - nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 avaLughghu ‘maryaM’ èn2abh bhèyariDhDhen2. avaLaiyuM, avaLuDhaiya jhandhadhiyaiyuM viraDhDhabhbhaDhDha SaidhdhAn2iDhamirundhu nI bhAdhughAghgha veNDhumèn2a nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 un2n2iDhaM bhirArdhdhighghir2en2!’’ èn2agh ghUr2in2AL.

Aghave, avaLuDhaiya ir2aivan2 avaLai (an2bhoDhu) azhaghAgha aGghIgharidhdhAn2. in2n2uM, azhaghiyamur2aiyil avaLai vaLarajh jhèydhAn2. in2n2uM, saghariyyAvai avaLughghu bhòr2ubhbhALarAghghin2An2. (avaL dhaGghi irundha) mADhadhdhil saghariyyA avaLiDhaM nuzhaiyuMbhodhèllAM, or uNavai avaLiDhaM ghaNDhAr. “maryame! èGghirundhu un2aghghu idhu (varughir2adhu)?’’ èn2agh ghUr2in2Ar. “idhu allAhviDhamirundhu (varughir2adhu). nijhjhayamAgha allAh - dhAn2 nADhughir2avarughghu - ghaNaghghin2r2i vazhaGghuvAn2’’ èn2a avaL ghUr2in2AL.

avviDhadhdhil saghariyyA dhan2 ir2aivan2ai bhirArdhdhidhdhAr. “èn2 ir2aivA! un2 bhur2adhdhilirundhu èn2aghghòru nalla (dhUymaiyAn2a) jhandhadhiyai dhA! nijhjhayamAgha nI bhirArdhdhan2aiyai nan2ghu jhèviyur2ubhavan2’’ èn2agh ghUr2in2Ar.

Agha, avar mADhadhdhil nin2r2u dhòzhudhu ghòNDhirughgha avarai vAn2avarghaL azhaidhdhArghaL: “allAhvin2 òru vAghghiyadhdhai uNmaibhbhaDhudhdhagh ghUDhiyavarAgha, dhalaivarAgha, jharIra in2bhadhdhaidh dhur2andhavarAgha, nabhiyAgha, nalloril òruvarAgha irughghin2r2a yahyA (èn2r2a òru magha)vaigh ghòNDhu nijhjhayamAgha allAh umaghghu nar2jhèydhi ghUr2ughir2An2’’ (èn2r2u vAn2avarghaL ghUr2in2ArghaL).

“èn2 ir2aivA! nAn2o mudhumai aDhaindhirughgha, èn2 man2aiviyo malaDhiyAgha irughgha, èn2aghghu èvvAr2u ghuzhandhai ghiDhaighghuM” èn2r2u (saghariyyA) ghUr2in2Ar. “(allAhvin2 ghaDhDhaLai) ivvAr2udhAn2. allAh, dhAn2 nADhiyadhai jhèyvAn2” èn2r2u allAh (bhadhil) ghUr2in2An2.

“èn2 ir2aivA! èn2aghghor adhdhADhjhiyai er2bhaDhudhdhu!’’ èn2r2u (saghariyyA) ghUr2in2Ar. “umaghghu adhdhADhjhiyAvadhu, jhADhaiyAgha dhavira mUn2r2u nADhghaL maghghaLuDhan2 nIr bhejhamuDhiyAmal irubhbhadhAghuM. in2n2uM, umadhu ir2aivan2ai adhighaM nin2aivu ghUrvIrAgha! mAlaiyiluM ghAlaiyiluM (subhhAn2allAh èn2r2u ghUr2i) avan2aidh dhudhibhbhIrAgha!’’ èn2r2u allAh (bhadhil) ghUr2in2An2.

“maryame! nijhjhayamAgha allAh uMmaidh dherndhèDhudhdhAn2; uMmaibh bharijhudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhin2An2; aghiladhdhArghaLin2 bhèNghaLaiviDha uMmaidh dherndhèDhudhdhAn2” èn2r2u vAn2avarghaL ghUr2iya jhamayadhdhai nin2aivu ghUrvIrAgha!
maryame! umadhu ir2aivan2ughghubh bhaNivIrAgha! (-nINDha neraM nin2r2u dhòzhuvIrAgha!) in2n2uM, jhiraM bhaNivIrAgha! (dhòzhughaiyil) ghun2ibhavarghaLuDhan2 ghun2ivIrAgha!

(nabhiye!) ivai mar2aivAn2a jhèydhighaLilirundhu uLLavai. ivar2r2ai umaghghu vahyi (mUlaM) ar2ivighghir2oM. avarghaLil yAr maryamai bhòr2ubhbhe(r2r2u vaLa)rbhbhAr èn2r2u (ar2iya) avarghaL dhaGghaL èzhudhugholghaLai (Ar2r2il) èr2in(dhu jhodhidh)dhabhodhu nIr avarghaLiDhaM irughghavillai. (idhaibh bhar2r2i) avarghaL dhaGghaLughghuL dharghghidhdhabhodhuM nIr avarghaLiDhaM irughghavillai.

“maryame! nijhjhayamAgha allAh dhan2n2iDhamirundhu (Aghugha! èn2r2a) òru vArdhdhaiyin2Al umaghghu (òru ghuzhandhaiyai ghòDhughgha) nar2jhèydhi ghUr2ughir2An2. adhan2 bhèyar al masIh IsA ibhn2u maryaM AghuM. (avar) indha ulaghadhdhiluM mar2umaiyiluM ghaMbhIramAn2avarAghavuM, (allAhvir2ghu) nèrughghamAn2avarghaLiluM irubhbhAr’’ èn2r2u vAn2avarghaL ghUr2iya jhamayadhdhai (nabhiye) nin2aivu ghUrvIrAgha!
in2n2uM, “avar dhòDhDhilil irughghuMbhodhuM, vAlibharAgha irughghuMbhodhuM maghghaLiDhaM bhejhuvAr. in2n2uM, (avar) nalloril uLLavar’’ (èn2r2uM vAn2avarghaL maryamiDhaM ghUr2in2ArghaL).

“èn2 ir2aivA! ADhavar òruvaruM èn2n2aidh dhòDhAmal irughgha, èn2aghghu èbhbhaDhi ghuzhandhai er2bhaDhuM?’’ èn2r2u (maryaM) ghUr2in2Ar. “(allAhvin2 nADhDhaM) ivvAr2udhAn2, allAh, dhAn2 nADhiyadhai (nADhiyabhaDhi) bhaDhaighghir2An2. avan2 òru ghAriyadhdhai muDhivu jhèydhAl adhar2ghu avan2 ghUr2uvadhèllAM ‘Aghugha’ èn2r2udhAn2. uDhan2e (adhu) AghiviDhuM” èn2r2u allAh ghUr2in2An2.
in2n2uM, èzhudhuvadhaiyuM JAn2adhdhaiyuM, dhavrAdhdhaiyuM in2jIlaiyuM avan2 avarughghugh ghar2bhibhbhAn2.

(IsA dhUdharAn2a bhir2aghu,) “nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 uGghaL ir2aivan2iDhamirundhu uGghaLughghu or adhdhADhjhiyaigh ghòNDhu vandhirughghir2en2. nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 uGghaLughghAgha ghaLimaNNilirundhu bhar2avaiyin2 uruva amaibhbhaibhbhol bhaDhaidhdhu, adhil Udhuven2. allAhvin2 an2umadhiyin2Al adhu bhar2avaiyAgha AghiviDhuM. in2n2uM, bhir2avigh ghuruDharaiyuM vèN ghuSDharaiyuM ghuNabhbhaDhudhdhuven2. in2n2uM, maraNidhdhoraiyuM allAhvin2 an2umadhiyin2Al uyirbhbhibhbhen2. in2n2uM, nIGghaL (aDhudhdha veLai) èn2n2a (uNavai) bhujhibhbhIrghaL èn2bhadhaiyuM, uGghaL vIDhughaLil nIGghaL èn2n2a jhemidhdhu vaighghir2IrghaL èn2bhadhaiyuM uGghaLughghu ar2ivibhbhen2. nijhjhayamAgha nIGghaL naMbhighghaiyALarghaLAgha irundhAl idhil uGghaLughghu or adhdhADhjhi dhiDhDhamAgha irughghir2adhu” (èn2r2u avar ghUr2in2Ar).

(IsA dhòDharndhu ghUr2iyadhAvadhu:) “in2n2uM, èn2aghghu mun2n2uLLa dhavrAdhdhai (nAn2) uNmaibhbhaDhudhdhubhavarAgha (irubhbhen2). in2n2uM, uGghaL mIdhu dhaDhughghabhbhaDhDhadhil jhilavar2r2ai uGghaLughghu nAn2 AghumAghghuvadhar2ghAghavuM (an2ubhbhabhbhaDhDhuLLen2). in2n2uM, uGghaL ir2aivan2iDhamirundhu or adhdhADhjhiyuDhan2 uGghaLiDhaM vandhirughghir2en2. Aghave, allAhvai aJjhuGghaL. in2n2uM èn2aghghu ghIzhbhbhaDhiyuGghaL.”
(IsA dhòDharndhu ghUr2iyadhAvadhu:) “nijhjhayamAgha allAhdhAn2 èn2adhu ir2aivan2uM, uGghaL ir2aivan2uM AvAn2. Aghave, nIGghaL avan2ai vaNaGghuGghaL. idhu nerAn2a vazhiyAghuM.’’

Agha, avarghaLil (bhalar dhaMmai) nirAgharibhbhadhai IsA uNarndha bhodhu, “allAhvir2ghAgha èn2adhu udhaviyALarghaL yAr?’’ èn2agh ghUr2in2Ar. (avaruDhaiya uNmaiyAn2a) dhozharghaL, “nAGghaL allAhvin2 (dhUdharAghiya umaghghu) udhaviyALarghaLAgha irubhbhoM. nAGghaL allAhvai naMbhighghai ghòNDhoM. in2n2uM, nijhjhayamAgha nAGghaL musliMghaL èn2a (nIr) jhADhjhi aLibhbhIrAgha’’ èn2r2u ghUr2in2ArghaL.

“èGghaL ir2aivA! nI ir2aghghiyadhai naMbhighghai ghòNDhoM. in2n2uM, indhadh dhUdharai bhin2bhar2r2in2oM. Aghave, jhADhjhiyALarghaLuDhan2 èGghaLai(yuM jhADhjhiyALarghaLAgha) bhadhivu jhèy!’’ (èn2r2u avarghaL bhirArdhdhidhdhan2ar).
avarghaL (-yUdharghaL) jhadhi jhèydhArghaL. allAhvuM jhadhi jhèydhAn2. allAhvo, jhadhi jhèybhavarghaLil migha melAn2avan2.

“IsAve nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 uMmai (bhUmiyilirundhu) ghaibhbhar2r2uven2; uMmai èn2 bhaghghaM uyardhdhuven2; nirAgharibhbhALarghaLilirundhu uMmaibh bharijhudhdhabhbhaDhudhdhuven2; uMmai (nabhiyAgha er2r2u) bhin2bhar2r2iyavarghaLai ir2udhinAL varai (umadhu nabhidhdhuvadhdhai) nirAgharidhdhavarghaLughghu melAgha Aghghuven2” èn2a allAh ghUr2iya jhamayadhdhai (nabhiye) nin2aivu ghUrvIrAgha! (nirAgharibhbhALarghaLe!) bhir2aghu èn2 bhaghghame uGghaL mILumiDhaM irughghir2adhu. Agha, (IsAvin2 viSayadhdhil) nIGghaL gharudhdhu ver2ubhADhu jhèydhu ghòNDhirundhadhu bhar2r2i uGghaLughghu madhdhiyil nAn2 dhIrbhbhaLibhbhen2.

Agha, èvarghaL (umadhu nabhidhdhuvadhdhai) nirAgharidhdhArghaLo (in2n2uM, umaghghu dhaghudhi illAdhadhai uMmuDhan2 iNaidhdhu bhejhin2ArghaLo) avarghaLai iMmaiyiluM mar2umaiyiluM ghaDhin2amAn2a dhaNDhan2aiyAl nAn2 dhaNDhibhbhen2. avarghaLughghu udhaviyALarghaLil èvaruM irughgha mADhDhAr.

Agha èvarghaL (uMmai èbhbhaDhi naMbhighghai ghòLLa veNDhumo abhbhaDhi) naMbhighghai ghòNDhu, nar2jhèyalghaLai jhèydhArghaLo avarghaLin2 (nar2)ghUlighaLai allAh avarghaLughghu muzhumaiyAgha vazhaGghuvAn2. allAh aniyAyaghghArarghaL mIdhu an2bhu vaighghamADhDhAn2.

(nabhiye!) nAM umaghghu odhigh ghANbhidhdha (IsAvaibh bhar2r2iya uNmaiyAn2a jharidhdhiraGghaLAghiya) avai (an2aidhdhuM umadhu nabhidhdhuvadhdhin2) adhdhADhjhighaLilirundhuM JAn2amighundha (ghurAn2 èn2n2uM) ar2ivuraiyilirundhuM uLLavai AghuM.

nijhjhayamAgha allAhviDhaM IsAvin2 uvamai AdhamuDhaiya uvamaiyaibh bhon2r2AghuM. avarai maNNilirundhu bhaDhaidhdhAn2. bhir2aghu, ‘Aghu’ èn2r2u avarai noghghi ghUr2in2An2. (uDhan2e avar man2idhan2Agha) AghiviDhDhAr.
(nabhiye! IsAvaibh bhar2r2iya indha) uNmai uM ir2aivan2iDhamirundhu vandhadhAghuM. Aghave, (idhai) jhandheghibhbhavarghaLil nIr AghiviDhAdhIr.

Agha, (nabhiye! idhaibhbhar2r2iya) ghalvi umaghghu vandha bhin2n2ar idhil yArAvadhu uMmiDhaM dharghghidhdhAl, (avarghaLai noghghi) ghUr2uvIrAgha: “vAruGghaL èGghaL bhiLLaighaLaiyuM, uGghaL bhiLLaighaLaiyuM, èGghaL bhèNghaLaiyuM, uGghaL bhèNghaLaiyuM, èGghaLaiyuM, uGghaLaiyuM azhaibhbhoM. bhir2aghu, (an2aivaruM òn2r2ughUDhi) mighundha bhayadhdhoDhuM bhaNivoDhuM man2r2ADhi bhirArdhdhibhbhoM. in2n2uM, bhòyyarghaL mIdhu allAhvin2 jhAbhadhdhai AghghuvoM.’’

nijhjhayamAgha idhudhAn2 uNmaiyAn2a varalAr2AghuM. (uNmaiyil vaNaGghadhdhaghudhiyAn2a) ir2aivan2 yAruM illai, allAhvaidh dhavira. in2n2uM nijhjhayamAgha allAh - avan2dhAn2 mighaidhdhavan2, maghA JAn2avAn2 AvAn2.
Agha, (avarghaL indha uNmai varalAr2r2ai) bhur2aghghaNidhdhAl, nijhjhayamAgha allAh (adhdhaghaiyai) viSamighaLai nan2ghar2indhavan2 AvAn2.

(nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha: “vedhaghghArarghaLe! èGghaL madhdhiyiluM uGghaL madhdhiyiluM (nIdhamAn2a) jhamamAn2a òru viSayadhdhin2 bhaghghaM vAruGghaL! adhAvadhu: allAhvaidh dhavira (èvaraiyuM nIGghaLuM nAmuM) vaNaGghamADhDhoM; avan2ughghu èdhaiyuM (nIGghaLuM nAmuM) iNaiyAghgha mADhDhoM; allAhvaidh dhavira naMmil jhilar jhilarai vaNaGghabhbhaDhuM dhèyvaGghaLAgha èDhudhdhugh ghòLLagh ghUDhAdhu.’’ (idhudhAn2 andha nIdhamAn2a jhamamAn2a viSayaM.) Agha, avarghaL (idhai er2ghAmal bhur2aghghaNidhdhu) vilaghi jhèn2r2Al, “nijhjhayamAgha nAGghaL musliMghaL èn2bhadhar2ghu nIGghaL jhADhjhi jhòlluGghaL!’’ èn2r2u nIGghaL (avarghaLiDhaM) ghUr2iviDhuGghaL.

in2n2uM, èvarghaL naM vajhan2aGghaLaibh bhòybhbhidhdhArghaLo, avarghaL bhAvaM jhèydhu ghòNDhirundha ghAraNadhdhAl dhaNDhan2ai avarghaLai vandhaDhaiyuM.

(nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha: ”allAhvin2 bhòghghiSaGghaL èn2n2iDhaM uLLan2a” èn2r2u nAn2 uGghaLughghugh ghUr2amADhDhen2. in2n2uM, nAn2 mar2aivAn2avar2r2ai ar2iya mADhDhen2. nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 òru vAn2avar èn2r2uM uGghaLughghu ghUr2amADhDhen2. èn2aghghu vahyi ar2ivighghabhbhaDhuvadhaidh dhavira nAn2 bhin2bhar2r2amADhDhen2.’’ (nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha: “ghuruDhan2uM, bhArvaiyuDhaiyavan2uM jhamamAvArghaLA? nIGghaL jhindhighgha mADhDhIrghaLA?’’

“nijhjhayamAgha nAn2, - èn2 ir2aivan2 èn2aghghu nerAn2a bhAdhaiyin2 bhaghghaM nervazhi ghADhDhi irughghir2An2. adhu (ivvulagha, mar2u ulagha vAzhghghaiyin2 dhevaighaLai uLLaDhaghghiya) nilaiyAn2a ur2udhiyAn2a mArghghamAghuM, ibhrAhIM uDhaiya ghòLghaiyAghuM. (nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha: “nijhjhayamAgha èn2 dhòzhughaiyuM, èn2 bhaliyuM (èn2adhu vaNaghgha vazhibhADhughaLuM), èn2 vAzhvuM èn2 maraNamuM aghiladhdhArin2 ir2aivan2Aghiya allAhvughghe uriyavai.”
“avan2ughghu iNai ar2ave illai; i(ndha dhUymaiyAn2a eghadhdhuvadh)dhaiye nAn2 evabhbhaDhDhuLLen2. in2n2uM, musliMghaLil (-avan2ughghu mur2r2iluM ghIzhbhbhaDhindhavarghaLil) nAn2 mudhalAmavan2.”

“nijhjhayamAgha nAGghaL naMbhighghai ghòLbhavarghaLil mudhalAmavarghaLAgha irubhbhadhAl èGghaL ir2aivan2 èGghaL ghur2r2aGghaLai èGghaLughghu man2n2ibhbhadhai nAGghaL mighavuM AjhaibhbhaDhughir2oM.”

ibhbhaDhidhdhAn2 (avarghaLai vèLiyer2r2in2oM). in2n2uM, avar2r2ai isravelarghaLughghu jhòndhamAghghin2oM.
Agha, (firavn2in2 ghUDhDhadhdhAr) ghAlaibh bhòzhudhil avarghaLaibh bhin2dhòDharndhan2ar.

(mUsA) ghUr2in2Ar: avvAr2alla. nijhjhayamAgha èn2n2uDhan2 èn2 ir2aivan2 irughghir2An2. avan2 èn2aghghu (viraivil) vazhighADhDhuvAn2.

“nIGghaLuM uGghaL mundhiya mUdhAdhaighaLuM (vaNaGghughin2r2a jhilaighaL bhar2r2i jhòlluGghaL.)”
“en2èn2il, nijhjhayamAgha avai èn2aghghu èdhirighaL AvArghaL. An2Al, aghilaGghaLin2 ir2aivan2aidh dhavira. (avan2dhAn2 èn2adhu nejhan2, nAn2 vaNaGghuM ghaDhavuL)”

“in2n2uM, avan2dhAn2 èn2aghghu uNavaLighghir2An2. in2n2uM, èn2aghghu nIr bhughaDhDhughir2An2.”

“in2n2uM, bhin2varuvorghaLil èn2aghghu nar2bhèyarai er2bhaDhudhdhuvAyAgha!”
“in2n2uM, èn2n2ai nayIM jhòrghghadhdhin2 vArijhughaLil AghghiviDhuvAyAgha!”
“in2n2uM, èn2 dhandhaighghu man2n2ibhbhaLibhbhAyAgha! nijhjhayamAgha avar vazhi dhavar2iyavarghaLil irughghir2Ar.”

in2n2uM, jhòrghghaM ir2aiyajhjhaM uLLavarghaLughghu jhamIbhamAghghabhbhaDhuM.

avarghaL adhil dharghghidhdhavarghaLAgha ghUr2uvArghaL:
“allAhvin2 mIdhu ANaiyAgha! nijhjhayamAgha nAM dhèLivAn2a vazhigheDhDhildhAn2 irundhoM,
uGghaLai aghilaGghaLin2 ir2aivan2ughghu jhamamAgha Aghghi (vaNaGghi)yabhodhu.
èGghaLai vazhi ghèDhughghavillai ghur2r2avALighaLaidh dhavira.

“nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 uGghaLughghu naMbhighghaighghuriya dhUdhar Aven2.”
“Aghave, allAhvai aJjhuGghaL! in2n2uM, èn2aghghu ghIzhbhbhaDhiyuGghaL!”

(avan2,) vAn2aGghaL, bhUmi, in2n2uM avai iraNDhughghuM iDhaiyil uLLavar2r2in2 urimaiyALan2, mighaidhdhavan2, maghA man2n2ibhbhALan2 (AvAn2).
(nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha! “i(ndha vedhamAn2a)dhu òru maghadhdhAn2a jhèydhiyAghuM.
nIGghaL idhai bhur2aghghaNighghir2IrghaL.”

migha uyarndha vAn2avarghaLaibh bhar2r2i, (Adhamai allAh bhaDhaibhbhadhar2ghu mun2n2ar avar viSayamAgha) avarghaL dharghghidhdha bhodhu (èn2n2a ghUr2in2ArghaL èn2r2u) èn2aghghu ar2ave JAn2aM illai. (allAh èn2aghghu adhai ghUr2iya bhin2n2ardhAn2 nAn2 adhai ar2iven2. Aghave, idhu dhèLivAn2a or AdhAramAgha illaiyA?)

(nabhiye!) andha jhamayadhdhai nin2aivu ghUrvIrAgha, umadhu ir2aivan2 vAn2avarghaLai noghghi ghUr2in2An2: “nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 ghaLimaNNilirundhu òru man2idharai bhaDhaighghabhbhoghir2en2”
“Agha, nAn2 avarai jhèMmaibhaDhudhdhi, avaril nAn2 bhaDhaidhdha uyirai Udhin2Al (vAn2avarghaLe!) nIGghaL avarughghu mun2 jhiraM bhaNindhavarghaLAgha vizhundhu viDhuGghaL!”
Agha, vAn2avarghaL, avarghaL òvvòruvaruM, avarghaL an2aivaruM jhiraM bhaNindhan2ar.

(SaidhdhAn2) ghUr2in2An2: “nAn2 avarai viDha jhir2andhavan2. nI èn2n2ai nèrubhbhil irundhu bhaDhaidhdhAy. in2n2uM, avarai maNNilirundhu bhaDhaidhdhAy.”
(allAh) ghUr2in2An2: “nI i(ndha jhòrghghadh)dhilirundhu vèLiyer2i viDhu! Agha, nijhjhayamAgha nI jhabhighghabhbhaDhDhavan2 AvAy.”
“in2n2uM, nijhjhayamAgha ghUli (ghòDhughghabhbhaDhuM mar2umai) nAL varai un2 mIdhu èn2 jhAbhaM uNDhAghaDhDhuM.”
(ibhlIs) ghUr2in2An2: “èn2 ir2aivA! Agha, avarghaL èzhubhbhabhbhaDhughin2r2a nAL varai èn2aghghu avaghAjhaM aLi!”
(allAh) ghUr2in2An2: “nijhjhayamAgha nI, avaghAjhamaLighghabhbhaDhDhavarghaLil irubhbhAy.”
“(mar2umaighghAn2a) ar2iyabhbhaDhDha neradhdhin2 nAL varuM varai (un2aghghu avaghAjhaM aLighghabhbhaDhuM).”
(ibhlIs) ghUr2in2An2: “Agha, un2adhu ghaNNiyadhdhin2 mIdhu jhadhdhiyamAgha avarghaL an2aivaraiyuM nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 vazhighèDhubhbhen2.”
“avarghaLil un2adhu bharijhudhdhamAn2a aDhiyArghaLaidh dhavira. (avarghaLai vazhighèDhughgha èn2n2Al muDhiyAdhu.)”
(allAh) ghUr2in2An2: “Agha, (idhudhAn2 èn2n2iDhamirundhu vandha) uNmaiyAghuM. nAn2 uNmaiyaidhdhAn2 ghUr2uven2.”
“un2n2AluM avarghaLil un2n2ai bhin2bhar2r2iyavarghaLAluM (uGghaL) an2aivarghaLAluM naraghadhdhai nirabhbhuven2.”
(nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha! “idhar2ghAgha nAn2 uGghaLiDhaM ghUli èdhaiyuM gheDhghavillai. in2n2uM, nAn2 (bhòyyAgha) varaDhDhu ghauravaM dheDhubhavarghaLil illai.”
(ghurAn2Aghiya) idhu illai, aghiladhdhArghaLughghu or ar2ivuraiyAghave dhavira.
idhan2 jhèydhiyai (adhu uNmaiyAn2adhu èn2r2u vèLibhbhaDhaiyAgha) jhila ghAladhdhir2ghubh bhin2n2ar nijhjhayaM nIGghaL ar2ivIrghaL.
mighaidhdhavan2uM maghA JAn2avAn2umAn2a allAhvin2 bhur2adhdhilirundhu ir2aghghabhbhaDhDha vedhamAghuM (idhu).
nijhjhayamAgha nAM indha vedhadhdhai uNmaiyuDhan2 umaghghu ir2aghghin2oM. Aghave, allAhvai vaNaGghuvIrAgha, vaNaghgha vazhibhADhughaLai - dhIn2ai avan2ughghu mur2r2iluM dhUymaibhbhaDhudhdhiyavarAgha.

ar2indhu ghòLLuGghaL! bharijhudhdhamAn2a vaNaghgha vazhibhADhughaL èllAM allAhvir2ghe uriyan2a. avan2ai an2r2i (bhala) dhèyvaGghaLai (dhaGghaLughghu) èDhudhdhugh ghòNDhavarghaL, “nAGghaL avarghaLai vaNaGghuvadhillai, allAhvin2 bhaghghaM andhasdhAl èGghaLai avarghaL nèrughghamAghghuvadhar2ghAghave dhavira.” èn2r2u ghUr2ughir2ArghaL. nijhjhayamAgha allAh avarghaLughghu madhdhiyil avarghaL gharudhdhu ver2ubhADhu jhèyghin2r2avar2r2il dhIrbhbhaLibhbhAn2. bhòyyarghaLai nirAgharibhbhALarghaLai nijhjhayamAgha allAh nervazhi jhèludhdhamADhDhAn2.

allAh òru ghuzhandhaiyai (dhan2aghghu) èDhudhdhughghòLLa nADhin2Al avan2 dhAn2 bhaDhaidhdhavar2r2il irundhu dhAn2 nADhuvadhai dherndhèDhudhdhirubhbhAn2. avan2 maghA bharijhudhdhamAn2avan2. avan2dhAn2 òruvan2uM aDhaghghi ALughir2avan2umAghiya allAh AvAn2.

avan2 vAn2aGghaLai, bhUmiyai uNmaiyAn2a ghAraNadhdhir2ghAgha bhaDhaidhdhAn2. bhaghal mIdhu iravai jhuruDhDhughir2An2. iravin2 mIdhu bhaghalai jhuruDhDhughir2An2. jhUriyan2aiyuM jhandhiran2aiyuM avan2 ghaDhDhubhbhaDhudhdhi vaidhdhuLLAn2. èllAM ghur2ibhbhiDhDha òru dhavaNaiyai noghghi oDhughin2r2an2a. ar2indhughòLLuGghaL! avan2dhAn2 mighaidhdhavan2, maghA man2n2ibhbhALan2.

avan2 uGghaLai òre or An2mAvil irundhu bhaDhaidhdhAn2. bhir2aghu, adhil irundhu adhan2 joDhiyai bhaDhaidhdhAn2. in2n2uM, avan2 uGghaLughghAgha ghAlnaDhaighaLil èDhDhu joDhighaLai uruvAghghin2An2. avan2 uGghaLai uGghaL dhAymArghaLin2 vayir2r2il (-dhAyin2 vayir2u, gharuvar2ai, naJjhughghòDhi Aghiya) mUn2r2u iruLghaLil òru bhaDhaibhbhughghubh bhin2n2ar in2n2òru bhaDhaibhbhAgha bhaDhaighghir2An2. avan2dhAn2 uGghaL ir2aivan2Aghiya allAh AvAn2. avan2ughghe ADhjhi an2aidhdhuM uriyadhu. avan2aidh dhavira (uNmaiyil vaNaGghadhdhaghudhiyAn2a) ir2aivan2 ar2ave illai. Agha, nIGghaL èvvAr2u (avan2ai viDhDhu ver2u òn2r2ai vaNaGghuvadhar2ghAgha dhijhaidh) dhirubhbhabhbhaDhughir2IrghaL.

nIGghaL nirAgharidhdhAl nijhjhayamAgha allAh uGghaLai viDhDhuM mur2r2iluM dhevaiyar2r2avan2 - (èllA vaghaiyiluM avan2) nir2aivAn2avan2. avan2 dhan2adhu aDhiyArghaLughghu nirAgharibhbhai viruMbha mADhDhAn2. nIGghaL nan2r2i jhèludhdhin2Al avan2 uGghaLughghu adhai viruMbhuvAn2. bhAviyAn2a or An2mA in2n2òru (bhAviyAn2a) An2mAvin2 bhAvadhdhai jhumaghghAdhu. bhir2aghu, uGghaL ir2aivan2 bhaghghame uGghaL mILumiDhaM irughghir2adhu. Agha, avan2 nIGghaL jhèydhu ghòNDhirundhadhai uGghaLughghu ar2ivibhbhAn2. nijhjhayamAgha avan2 nèJjhaGghaLil uLLadhai nan2ghar2indhavan2 AvAn2.

man2idhan2ughghu òru dhIGghu er2bhaDhDhAl avan2 dhan2 ir2aivan2ai avan2 bhaghghaM mur2r2iluM dhiruMbhiyavan2Agha azhaidhdhu bhirArdhdhighghir2An2. bhir2aghu, (ir2aivan2) dhan2 bhur2adhdhilirundhu avan2ughghu or aruLai vazhaGghin2Al idhar2ghu mun2n2ar avan2iDhaM bhirArdhdhibhbhavan2Agha irundhadhai avan2 mar2andhu viDhughir2An2. in2n2uM, allAhvir2ghu iNai(yAgha ghar2bhan2ai dhèyvaG)ghaLai er2bhaDhudhdhughir2An2, avan2uDhaiya bhAdhaiyai viDhDhu (maghghaLai) vazhighèDhubhbhadhar2ghAgha (ivvAr2u jhèyghir2An2). (nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha! “nI un2adhu nirAgharibhbhaigh ghòNDhu jhir2idhu (ghAlaM) jhughamaDhaindhughòL! nijhjhayamAgha nI naraghavAjhighaLil òruvan2dhAn2.”

yAr mar2umaiyai bhayandhu, dhan2 ir2aivan2in2 aruLai Ajhai vaidhdhu, iravu neraGghaLil jhiraM bhaNindhavarAghavuM nin2r2avarAghavuM allAhvai vaNaGghuvAro avar allAhvai nirAgharibhbhavarughghu jhamamAvArA? (nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha! “(allAhvai vaNaGghi avan2ughghu ghIzhbhbhaDhivadhil uLLa nan2maiyai) ar2indhavarghaLuM (adhai) ar2iyAdhavarghaLuM jhamamAvArghaLA? nallubhadhejhaM bhèr2uvadhèllAM nir2aivAn2a ar2ivuDhaiyavarghaLdhAn2.”

(nabhiye nAn2 èn2 aDhiyArghaLughghu ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhuvadhAgha) ghUr2uvIrAgha! “naMbhighghai ghòNDha èn2 aDhiyArghaLe! uGghaL ir2aivan2ai aJjhuGghaL! ivvulaghil nan2mai jhèydhavarghaLughghu (mar2umaiyil) nan2mai (-jhòrghghaM) uNDhu. in2n2uM allAhvin2 bhUmi vijhAlamAn2adhAghuM. bhòr2umaiyALarghaLughghu avarghaLadhu ghUli (mar2umaiyil) vazhaGghabhbhaDhuvadhèllAM ghaNaghghin2r2idhAn2. (muDhivur2Adha nar2bhAghghiyaGghaLai avarghaL an2ubhavibhbhArghaL.)”

(nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha! “allAhvai nAn2 vaNaGgha veNDhuM, mArghghadhdhai - vaNaghgha vazhibhADhughaLai avan2ughghu (maDhDhuM) nAn2 dhUymaiyAgha jhèyya veNDhuM” èn2r2u nijhjhayamAgha nAn2 ghaDhDhaLaiyiDhabhbhaDhDhuLLen2.

(nabhiye!) ghUr2uvIrAgha! “allAhvaidhdhAn2 nAn2 vaNaGghuven2, avan2ughghu (maDhDhuM) èn2 mArghghadhdhai - vaNaghgha vazhibhADhDhai dhUymaibhbhaDhudhdhiyavan2Agha irughghuM nilaiyil.”

allAh migha azhaghiya bhejhjhai - bhalamur2ai odhabhbhaDhughin2r2a, òn2r2ughghòn2r2u òbhbhAn2a - òru vedhamAgha ir2aghghin2An2. dhaGghaL ir2aivan2ai bhayabhbhaDhubhavarghaLin2 dholghaL a(dhai avarghaL odhuva)dhan2 mUlaM jhilirghghin2r2an2a. bhir2aghu, avarghaLin2 dholghaLuM avarghaLin2 uLLaGghaLuM allAhvin2 nin2aivin2 bhaghghaM dhiruMbhi mèn2maiyAghi (amaidhi bhèr2ughi)n2r2an2a. idhudhAn2 allAhvin2 nervazhiyAghuM. dhAn2 nADhiyavarghaLai avan2 idhan2mUlaM nervazhi jhèludhdhughir2An2. allAh èvarai vazhighèDhughghir2An2o avarai nervazhibhaDhudhdhubhavar yAruM illai.

indha ghurAn2il maghghaLughghu èllA udhAraNaGghaLaiyuM nAM dhiDhDhavaDhDhamAgha vivaridhdhoM, avarghaL nallubhadhejhaM bhèr2uvadhar2ghAgha.
ghuzhabhbhamuM, ghoNaluM illAdha, arabhi mòzhi ghurAn2Agha (nAM idhai Aghghin2oM), avarghaL (idhai bhaDhidhdhu, uNarndhu allAhvai) aJjhuvadhar2ghAgha.

(idhu naMbhighghaiyALarughghAn2a udhAraNamAghuM.) indha iraNDhu nabharghaLuM dhan2maiyAl jhamamAvArghaLA? èllAbhbhughazhuM allAhvir2ghe. mAr2Agha, avarghaLil adhighamAn2avarghaL (dhaGghaL vazhigheDhDhai) ar2iyamADhDhArghaL.
nijhjhayamAgha nIruM maraNibhbhavare! in2n2uM, nijhjhayamAgha avarghaLuM maraNibhbhavarghaLdhAn2.

Agha, allAhvin2 mIdhu bhòy jhòlbhavan2ai viDhavuM uNmaiyai - adhu avan2iDhaM vandhabhodhu - bhòybhbhidhdhavan2ai viDhavuM maghA aniyAyaghghAran2 yAr? nirAgharibhbhavarghaLughghu naraghadhdhil dhaGghumiDhaM illaiyA? (ghaNDhibhbhAgha aGghudhAn2 avarghaLin2 dhaGghumiDhaM irughghir2adhu.)
èvar uNmaiyaigh ghòNDhu vandhAro in2n2uM èvar adhai uNmai èn2r2u er2r2Aro avarghaLdhAn2 ir2aiyajhjhaM uLLavarghaL.
avarghaLughghu avarghaLin2 ir2aivan2iDhaM avarghaL nADhaghghUDhiyadhèllAM ghiDhaighghuM. idhudhAn2 nallavarghaLin2 vèghumadhiyAghuM.
